styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-stage fitness ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of stage near-black #111111, carbon grey #232323, light grey text #F2F2F0 and one vivid yellow accent #F7C600, with pure white #FFFFFF reserved for the marketplace packshot and light neutral #EDEDEA for the spec screen; neutral temperature; dramatic single-spot studio key with a subtle rim light, soft grounded contact shadows, controlled highlights on coated metal, no mixed light directions; modern bold geometric sans-serif headline typography; thin-line icons in light grey #F2F2F0 with yellow #F7C600 accents; clean high-end fitness product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered product staging, consistent set scale and balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
